description: This PHP file contains automated tests for the CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPI within the Recruitment module of the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing various API endpoints and functionalities related to candidate interview scheduling.

classes.name: CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CandidateInterviewSchedulingAPI endpoints related to recruitment candidate interview scheduling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables related to interviews and candidate history.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of the API, expecting it to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests validation rules for fetching all interview schedules, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of an interview schedule with mock services and fixtures using data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testCreate' method from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete method of the API, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for delete operation, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single interview schedule by ID, expecting a valid response.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetOne' method from a YAML data source.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an interview schedule with mock data and services.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testUpdate' method from a YAML data source.
